findings.message: Child-safe hard speed cap implemented: _speed vector is clamped to MAX_SPEED (20.0) preventing excessive velocity. Fixes prior InputEvent misuse that caused unbounded acceleration.
findings.resolution: Speed clamping prevents vehicle from exceeding safe limits

findings.message: Safe egress with raycast fallback to last grounded position implemented. On vehicle exit, a raycast down from the player position finds ground or falls back to the last known grounded position, preventing endless fall.
findings.resolution: Players cannot fall through world on vehicle egress

findings.message: Collision layer/mask restoration on enter/exit ensures vehicle doesn't lose collision group membership.
_assert_vehicle_safety_and_fallbacks regression test covers: speed cap, ramp grounded collision, void-safe egress, collision restore, fist fallback, equipped-tool fallback. All assertions pass.
findings.resolution: Comprehensive vehicle safety regression coverage in place

findings.message: _spawn_npcs no longer early-returns on empty roster. Starter camp residents always spawn regardless of roster state.
findings.resolution: Camp civilians spawn reliably even with empty adventure roster

findings.message: NPC collision shapes are named for testability. Each NPC has a named CollisionShape3D child node for automated verification.
findings.resolution: Named collision shapes enable automated testing

findings.message: Camp civilian regression test validates: residents spawn with empty roster, grounded StaticBody3D, CapsuleShape3D collision, GreetTrigger Area3D, wander metadata, greeting and safe fart-reaction lines, wander loop stays grounded, dialogue label show/hide.
set_adventure_music_state supports 'explore', 'danger', 'drive', 'night' states with curated Gen-Z phonk tracks. Two AudioStreamPlayers (MusicPlayer, MusicPlayerSecondary) enable seamless crossfades.
findings.resolution: Music system supports continuous crossfading between exploration, danger, and driving states

findings.message: rotate_adventure_track cycles through state-specific beds via seamless crossfade. Keeps long sandbox sessions lively without cutting music.
_tick_adventure_music integrates with audio bank to trigger state transitions. Music updates based on session elapsed time with configurable rotation intervals per state.
findings.resolution: Music system integrated into gameplay runtime

findings.message: Sitting never disables player collision. The CapsuleShape3D remains active when player is seated in a vehicle or on furniture.
Streamed terrain or furniture faults return player to last grounded position instead of endless fall. Safety fallback mechanism in place.
findings.resolution: Terrain fault recovery prevents endless fall

summary: VS-048 implementation complete: vehicle safety (speed cap, safe egress, collision restoration), camp civilians (reliable spawning, grounded characters, interaction/reaction lines), and music crossfade (continuous ambient bed with state-based transitions) all meet acceptance criteria. All regression tests pass. Ready for claude cross-review.
